summary: Full end-to-end validation of MOVA (backend + frontend). Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/logout/me), safety check-in, SOS create + admin listing, location tracking + admin listing, bug reports, transit stops/routes, police, and role-based access (403 on admin-only endpoints for regular users). Frontend: admin login routes to /admin and shows MOVA Command Center with 4 KPI cards + live map + tabs; non-admin correctly redirected from /admin to /; registration works and greeting shows 'Good morning, <FirstName>'; Safety Check-in dialog auto-opens for users without alt_phone and is PIXEL-PERFECT centered (dialog center 720,450 matches viewport center 720,450 at 1440x900) with all labels and inputs fully visible; SOS FAB opens confirmation dialog listing alt contact; sending SOS posts to /api/sos and toast shows 'Nearest police: Infocity Police Station'; admin sees new SOS in dashboard; plan route draws polyline between D1/D2 with success toast; theme toggle correctly flips .light class on <html>; bug report dialog opens, submits, and admin sees it; offline page displays 'no satellite connection' heading; voice mic buttons render next to D1/D2 (2 present). The previously reported clipping glitch of the Safety Check-in dialog caused by Leaflet z-index is FULLY RESOLVED — the .leaflet-pane z-index override in index.css correctly places all leaflet layers below shadcn Dialog (z-50).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py bcrypt hashing uses gensalt() default which is fine; login endpoint does not implement brute-force lockout (playbook mentions 5-attempt lockout) — consider adding rate limiting for production.
CORS_ORIGINS default '*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; ensure CORS_ORIGINS is set to explicit origins in .env for production.
No pagination on /sos/all, /bugs, /location/all — currently capped at .to_list(200/500) which is acceptable for MVP but should be paginated when data grows.
Location endpoint accepts any lat/lng without range validation (e.g., -90..90 / -180..180). Minor hardening opportunity.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@mova.app / mova@admin123 (verified working). Test users freshly registered per run.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral test users user{ts}@mova.app and safe{ts}@mova.app during automation; created TEST_ prefixed bug reports and SOS entries visible in admin dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All test IDs are stable and reliable. backend_test.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and can be re-run as regression suite. Safety-checkin dialog centering was the primary reported issue — validated fully centered at multiple viewport sizes via bounding_box check. If retesting, be aware that clicking header buttons (logout, theme-toggle, report-bug) can be occluded briefly by top-right sonner toasts; use force=True and small waits (~500ms) after prior actions that produce toasts.
rca of the issue: Original clipping bug RCA: Leaflet's default .leaflet-pane / .leaflet-top / .leaflet-bottom / .leaflet-control z-index (400/1000) rendered above shadcn Dialog overlay+content (z-50), causing the Safety Check-in dialog to appear behind/clipped by map controls. Fix applied in /app/frontend/src/index.css sets all leaflet pane classes to z-index 1-5 !important and adds isolation:isolate on .leaflet-container. Verified fixed: dialog renders fully centered at (720,450) inside 1440x900 viewport with all form fields fully visible and interactive.
